notes.title: The "Foodies, Unite!" Update
notes.notes:
\[ MASSIVE FIX : PLEASE READ ]
In New Day, accessories have never been able to transfer to another save file because of issues with the islander's save file code. However, recently, I've adjusted said code to add new variables so that save files can be updated/not break with future updates. This had a drawback... unfortunately, accessories that you've previously given to your islander are no longer going to be on your islander. They should still have them obtained, but you'll have to reapply them whenever you visit their apartment next. As unfortunate as this is, it brings good news to the game! Shared islanders are now going to be able to have their accessories upon being shared! So, yay!

The UI is currently being updated, so some areas of the game may look more polished than others.
\[ Steam Achievements ]
Steam achievements are now in New Day! There's only a limited amount for the time being, but soon enough, we'll have a lot for you, the player, to unlock! We're looking forward to this great addition for New Day.
\[ Steam Islander Integration ] 
You can now export your islanders to the Steam Workshop directly from the game. Go into the Islander Creator, click on the islander you want to export and use that nifty Steam button to export them directly! 

And if you don't feel like you're in a creative mood, then you can always select the Steam Workshop button on the main screen of the Islander Creator and import other player's islanders directly into your game!
\[ New Customization Option : Facial Weight ]
You can now change your islander's facial weight separate from their bodies main weight. This is to add variety in facial shapes while also having your islanders be different sizes body-wise. I know, I know, this has been a requested feature for a while, but you're finally getting it now!
\[ New Feature : Foodie Food Stall ]
Foodie islanders on your island can now open a food stall! This means that whenever it's open, you'll be able to visit and buy discounted foods... depending on how the islander running the stall likes you or not.
\[ New Feature : Food Delivery Service App ]
Yup, you read that right! A new app has appeared on your phone... but what could it be?... Oh! It's a delivery service specializing in food?! Interesting! With the new food delivery app, you'll be able to assign specific islanders to get food delivered at 12:00 PM daily, straight to their tummies! But watch out... if your islander doesn't have a bank account or sufficient funds... all of that payment comes back to YOU. And if you don't have enough, well, tell your islanders bye-bye to their daily food rations! 
\[ New Ordinance : Less Time, More Action ]
Skip past an in-game day or an in-game week with this new ordinance available from Zephyr!
\[ Bug-Fixes ]
Fixed a bug where you could change the SPM of your island to 0 and negative numbers.

Fixed a bug where islanders would retain crushes on islanders who already have a partner.

Fixed a bug that caused you to not be able to revoke gifted items if you bought 1 of said item and gave it to your islander.

Fixed a bug that caused islanders to gain crushes on other islanders even if they had a partner.

Fixed a bug that caused skipping time to not actually produce more islander problems.

Fixed a bug where the clock can appear as "10:253459" and so on.

Attempted to fix the "Endless Loading" UI bug. 
\[ Additions/Improvements ]\[ Menu Reworks ]
The Apartment Complex's UI has been updated.

The "Delete an Islander" menu that you can access from the boat on the island has now been updated.

The "Load an Islander" menu in the Islander Creator has now been updated.

The "Islander's Apartment" UI has been slightly updated.
\[ Food Rework ]
Food will now apply all ingredient's hunger meters together to raise an islander's hunger, since ingredients have their own hunger bar. Before, ingredients didn't matter in how much hunger your islanders gained from a food item.
( Islander Creator )
Added 5 new glasses.

Added 5 new facial hairs.
( Wallpapers )
Added 18 new wallpapers to the Room Editor/Custom Layout Creator.
( Knit's Nifty Clothing )
Added 9 swatch types for the "Striped Dress".

Added 1 new swatch type for the "Prairie Dress".
( Islanders )
Your islanders will now wave at you if you enter their apartment and they have a high opinion of you.

Islanders are now more likely to have an argument if their relationship with each other is low, regardless of relationship status.
( Islander Problems )
Islanders should now have more frequent problems. This can be lowered / raised by enabling the proper ordinances from Zephyr in the Town Hall.

Added a new (Paranoid) problem, "Friend in the Walls".

Added a new (Foodie) problem, "Baked it Myself".

Added a new (Foodie) problem, "What a Recipe!".
( Islander Dreams )
Added a new dream, "Stretched Face".
( Fredbook )
Deleted islanders will now have deleted comments on Fredbook posts.

The comments screen has been reorganized to better show off your islander's comments on Fredbook posts.
( Koko )
You can now disable / re-enable bugs that spawn on your island from Koko by chatting with her on Kiki's Island.
( Added Achievements )
Date Night

Missing someone, eh?

End of an Era
( Bowling )
Added keyboard controls.

notes.title: Early Access: V.04 - The Confessions Update
notes.notes:
\[ New Feature: Confessions ]
Yes, it's finally here. The confessions update. I know, I know, it took a while to get it out to the public... but trust me, we were working on all sorts of other cool things to release alongside this update. It was 100% worth it in my opinion. Anywho... confessions are little cutscenes that can happen if an islander gains a crush on another islander. You're able to choose where they confess at and what they say during said confessions. But beware... if your islander isn't the only one who wants to confess to their crush, you might be dealing with a bit of drama on your island.

Along with confessions comes biological islander babies! That's right, when two islanders are together in a relationship and are content in what they have, they'll decide together that they want a baby. Babies are generated based on both parents personalities, skin color, hair color, etc. Hair color and skin color can even be a blend of both islanders... since they ARE clay! And, coming along with biological babies is... the official New Day "Sex Update"! (Not really, but a slight cutscene will occur where you can slightly see how islander babies are made... interesting, right?...)

And of course, to end off the "confession" notes, your islanders can break up with each other, too. I know, I know... that's to be expected... but soon, when we implement more personalities into New Day, you'll see why I mentioned it here... hehe...


\[ Massive Fix : Importing Islanders ]
Islanders that're imported that use "," instead of "." will now properly import into your game! How fun is that?! Now, everyone, all over the world, can share their islanders to ANYONE they want! 


\[ New Feature: Arguments / Fights ]
Islanders are now able to fight each other.

That's... all I wanna say here. You have to play the game in order to see what'll happen between your islanders.


\[ New Ordinance: "Gotta Love Fast" ]
With "Gotta Love Fast", your islander's relationships will be speed up times 3! You'll no longer have to wait around for your islanders to lose friendships, gain crushes, or any of that boring stuff. However, don't leave it enabled for too long... you wouldn't want your island to break out into chaos, now would you?...


\[ New Feature : Facial Markings ]
In the Islander Creator, you can now create "facial markings" on your islander. This feature allows you to draw on your islanders face with multiple colors and even allows you to change the brush size! Honestly, it's one of the best features we've created recently and it helps out if you're not used to the makeup system. 

Side note, if you circle the front portion of your islander's face, save them, quit the game, go to their file in the StreamingAssets folder of the game's directory, you can place an image inside of the circle you created to put a custom face in the game. Like if you wanted to take the face of a popular YouTuber or game character and placed the image on the bounds of the circle, then saved it. It'll appear in-game the next time you load in. Or if you wanted to give your islanders some ears. Who knows!


\[ New Feature : Befriending Shopkeepers ]
You can now befriend 2 shopkeepers. Fredrick and Zephyr. Once befriended, an option to receive a gift will appear.


\[ New Feature : The Baby Previewer ] 
When loading into Fredrick's portion of the Town Hall, you'll now be given the option to "Preview a Baby Islander" from two existing islanders. This feature is in the game to give a potential outlook of how a baby would theoretically look between two of your islanders before they even have a baby!


\[ New Feature : Islander Depression ]
Islanders can now become depressed if they are rejected in a confession sequence. Currently, this is the only way to trigger depression. In the future, various other reasons can affect an islander and cause them to become depressed too. You cannot cure an islander's depression. The best way to help them get through their emotions is to let them be.


\[ New Minigame : Shopkeeper Showdown ]
Shopkeeper Showdown is a new minigame that you can unlock after befriending Fredrick! Shopkeeper Showdown is a board game inspired by the classic Monopoly, but with a twist. Upon landing on another space with a shopkeeper, you two will have to fight to the death! Only one winner can come out on top, will that be you?


\[ New Feature : The Dark Web ]
The dark web is a new app on the player's phone that is unlocked after befriending Zephyr. Once you've unlocked the app, you'll gain access to a multitude of dangerous (and illegal, by Fredrick's terms...) items to give your islanders.


\[ New Feature : Gifting Islanders ]
You can now gift islanders gifts that you've bought from the dark web. Fortunately, this system was made in-mind of the gift shop feature coming in a future build, so when that time comes it'll be so much easier to implement. You can also take back the item given to the islander... just in-case you don't want said islander to be using it anymore.


\[ New Accessibility Option : Islander Creator ]
You're now able to use toggle the wheelchair option in the Islander Creator to place your islander into a wheelchair. This is currently in beta testing, but it doesn't harm anyone by putting it in the game early, right?


\[ The Room Editor: Custom Layouts ]
We've heard your cries, we've heard your pleas. We know what you want, and it's a new apartment editor. And that's what this update hopes to bring to you! You'll now be able to create custom layouts for your islander's apartments that you'll be able to use in The Room Editor. To access the new layout creator, head over to the Room Editor and select "Create Custom Apartment Layout"!


\[ UI Revamps ]
The Islander Creator and The Room Editor has received a huge overhaul of the UI. Now, both areas in the game have matching artstyles that're consistent with the main portions of New Day.


\[ New Settings Option : Disable Dynamic Icons ]
Dynamic icons are the icons that appear in your islander's apartment windows whenever they have a problem. The icons are unique to each problem an islander can have, which can sometimes ruin the surprise of what your islander wants! Enabling this feature in the settings menu will revert all islander icons back to the basic "has problem" icon... y'know, just in case you're trying to keep the mystery alive.


\[ Bug-Fixes ]
Fixed a bug that caused the mannequin in the shop portion of Knits Nifty Clothing to have a ghost tail if the first islander you've ever created was dead.

Fixed a bug that caused the text box that appears when you hover over a building to appear while you're not on the island.

Fixed a bug that caused viewing stats between two islanders on their Fredbook profiles to break if you've previously deleted an islander.

Attempted to fix the "Endless Loading UI" bug.

Attempted to fix the "Entering an Islander's apartment will send you to an island view" bug.

Load times should now be faster. (This, unfortunately, has made the game larger in file size.)

Loyal islanders will no longer lose XP/Opinion of you if you decline one of their problem requests.

You can now no longer select "The Afterlife isn't Real" ordinance while having the "Beware the Evil Islander" ordinance activated.

Islander's wants to have babies when the "More Babies" ordinance is active has now been halved.

Adopted babies no longer have the "Was Born on Island" icon selected on their social media profile.

Speeding up 6 hours using the "Skip 6 Hours" feature should no longer take absolutely forever.


\[ Additions/Improvements ]

( Islander Problems )
Added a new problem, "Worst Word".

Added a new problem, "Worst Word Usage".

Added a new (Social Butterfly) problem, "Bigger Islander".

Added a new (Athletic) problem, "Fire Workout".

Added a new problem, "Mugging another Islander", obtained by giving an islander a gun.

Added a new problem, "Couples want a Biological Baby".

Added a new problem, "Islander Wants to Confess their Feelings".

Added a new problem, "Chat Positively about Partner".

Added a new problem, "Break up with Partner".

Added a new problem, "Reminisce about Memory".

Added a new problem, "Fight with Other Islander".

All personalities now have their own lines for the "Lockpicking" minigame dialogues.

Restored the unique poses that appear in the islander's apartment windows when they have certain problems to be solved.


( Room Editor )
Added a new piece of "Living Room" furniture -- "Legally Distinct Armchair".

The camera in the Room Editor now behaves similarly to games like The Sims -- this also applies to The Layout Creator.

Importing rooms now has to be done by copying the code and pressing the "Paste Room Code" button.


( Island )
Leaves will now fall from trees, unless it's winter.

Leaf piles will now appear under trees with leaves falling from them.

Bugs now shrink when clicked, giving a clear visual cue that they’ve been collected.

You can now view your islander's birthdays on the phone's calendar menu.

Updated the UI displayed for viewing the stats between two islander's social media profiles.

The front door to the Apartment Complex will now open/close depending on if an islander is near it or not.


( Kiki's Island )
Replaced the Kiki's Island soundtrack with a new, original track.


( Bowling )
Replaced the bowling soundtrack with a new, original track that fits the vibe better.


( MemoMart )
Replaced the MemoMart soundtrack with a new, original track.


( Quirks )
Changed "Anti-Social" to "Asocial".

Implemented the "Impulsive" Quirk.

Implemented the "Attractive" Quirk.


( Food )
You can now feed your islanders any ingredients.


( Islander Creator )
Added 1 new hairstyle.

Added 48 new eyes (...175 in total!)

Added 16 new mouths (...96 in total!)

Added 32 new eyebrows (...79 in total!)

Islanders will now T-Pose in the Islander Creator... because they shouldn't be alive yet... you're still molding their clay!

Importing islanders now has to be done by copying the code and pressing the "Paste Islander Code" button.


( Aliens )
Added a new antenna option -- "Cheese".

Dialogue choices when doing islander problems will now use the alien font with the regular text options.


( Tooltips )
Tooltips now flip to the opposite side of the cursor when near the edge of the screen, making sure that they remain fully visible and no longer get obscured by the mouse pointer.


( MISC )
Werewolves are now able to wear clothes.

Islander's partners will now appear in their apartment if you preview an islander's baby.

notes.notes:
WARNING: This update will break all previous rooms you've created. You'll have to delete & recreate them.

[ Importing your Friend's Islanders! ]
You can now import islanders into your game. All you need to do is to get the islander's (albeit lengthy) code from another player and copy/paste that into the Islander Code Importer in the Islander Creator! This is a huge step in the right direction for New Day as we've never had something like this in the game before. We hope to see people sharing islanders soon!

[ Importing your Friend's Rooms! ]
You can now import rooms into your game. The process for implementing this is the same as your islander's codes. 

[ Fredrick: The Shopkeeper ]
Fredrick is now implemented in the game as the 3rd shopkeeper residing in the Town Hall. If you want to change the SPM (Seconds per Minute) of your island or your island's name, visit Fredrick!

And with adding Fredrick as a shopkeeper, I've changed how your island's name works! You can now type up to 64 characters, include spaces, numbers, symbols, etc! Feel free to get creative with your island's name.

[ Bug-Fixes ]

 Fixed a bug that caused an islander to continuously dump out a box of pampas if they were visiting their friends apartment and chatting with them.
 Fixed a typo in the "jail your islander" button tooltip.
 Islanders will no longer phase through the walls that you can place down in the Room Editor.
 Hopefully fixed the issue where the game would cause a white screen on subsequent play sessions if you previously crashed.
 The Phrygian Cap has been moved slightly lower to hide any hair that cuts off.
 Optimized the island scene a bit more!
 Fixed a visual glitch that caused stars to grow extremely large if you sped up the time on the island.
 Fixed an oversight that caused the "o" mouth to appear when an islander is talking even if the islander has their mouth removed.


[ Additions/Improvements ]

( Islanders )

 In the past, islanders who are visiting another islander's apartment were unable to do anything but talk to the owner of said apartment. Now, islanders aren't restricted to just chatting with each other. They're able to do whatever they want in their friends apartment! From dumping out a box of pampas to doing some workouts! Neat, right?
 Islanders will now interact with the furniture in their apartment, such as their bed, chairs, etc!


( Islander Quirks )

 Added a new quirk: Antisocial.
 Added a new quirk: Boring.


( Islander Dreams )

 Added a new dream -- "Magical Girl Transformation".


( Islander Animations )

 Improved the "Nodding No" animation.
 Improved the "Nodding Yes" animation.
 Improved all 3 "Talking" animations.


( Islander Problems )

 Added a new islander problem that islanders can gain if they've unsuccessfully tried to befriend another islander.


( Makeup )

 Added 13 new makeup pieces.


( Room Editor )

 Added 23 new wallpaper.
 Added 1 new flooring.


( Text Editor )

 Added the "Magical Girl Transformation" dream dialogue to the Text Editor.

notes.title: Early Access: V.03: The Shopkeepers Update
notes.notes:
Welcome back everyone! We here at Scrapbook Studios hope that you all have had an amazing Valentines day in February. 

Welcome to the Shopkeepers update. 

This update aims to add a variety of new mechanics in order to keep that love for your island alive... such as... Gardening, Bug Collecting, Chatting with all Shopkeepers, Bowling, and more! We hope you enjoy what this update brings to the game. 

We acknowledge that this may not be the update that everyone wants, aka, the confessions update. But it's still in development. We hope to release it to the public very, very soon.

[ New Shopkeeper : Nyx ]
Nyx is the shopkeeper of the Arcade. The arcade is a little "getaway" area from your island. You can go and play some arcade-based games and even earn money from them! Within the arcade, you can even get up to some... *gulp*... gambling!... but don't tell anyone that I told you!. Especially Fredrick. We don't want him to shut down the arcade!

[ New Shopkeeper : Koko ]
Koko is one out of the two shopkeepers of Kiki's Garden. She roams Kiki's island and keeps the local pests from invading her crops! Koko loves to collect bugs, and will pay a hefty sum to get her hands on all sorts of critters. Collect bugs by clicking on them when they appear on the screen while you view your main island! 

[ New Shopkeeper : Kiki ]
Kiki is the second shopkeeper that resides in Kiki's Garden. She roams the island and keeps all of the crops in order. You can buy seeds from her and plant your own crops in order to gain a significant amount of money or harvest the crop to obtain ingredients that your islanders can use for consumption!

[ New Feature(???) : Chatting with Shopkeepers ]
While this feature isn't really "new", as it was used for Toasty for the longest time, it's now available to all shopkeepers! Every shopkeeper will have their own dialogue, their own lore, their own story. If you're interested in the backstory and history of New Day, speak to the shopkeepers. In the future, I'd like to create a friendship bar with the shopkeepers that'll raise/lower depending on the options you pick in response to their conversations. That'd be neat!

[ New Feature : Islander Wants ]
Every in-game day, your islander will generate with 3 wants. Wants in New Day are things that your islander is requesting. Islanders can want to be punched, want to play Card Roulette, etc. Completing one of their wants will raise their opinion of you significantly and will raise their XP level. This allows islanders to feel like actual, living creatures rather than just your punching bags.

[ New Ordinance : Beware the Evil Islander ]
You can now buy the most expensive ordinance, Beware the Evil Islander, and allow your evil islanders to murder other islanders.

[ New Feature : Jail your Islander ]
Jailing an islander will cause the islander to become unable to leave the apartment building and unable kill other islanders. It's the perfect feature for when you want to keep an islander confined to their living quarters.

[ New Ordinance : Game Night ]
You can now buy "Game Night" to allow your islanders to play minigames more often.

[ Memories : Update ]
Islander's memories now have "positive/negative/neutral" tags attached to them. This will be important in a future update.
To not break the game, any previous memory made before this update will appear as a neutral memory type.
You can now also delete memories to prevent any unwanted bloat in your save file! And... well... if you don't want your islander to remember the bad moments they've had in life.

[ MISC ]
We've received a lot of complaints about in-game time not progressing while you're off doing other things, such as fishing or playing Card Roulette. While this is not ideal, it was how the game was hardcoded. However, with this update, that's completely changed. Now, no matter where you are, your island time will progress naturally, and so does your islander's problems. Maybe now you won't always be stuck on "Spring" and you'll be able to progress to other in-game seasons.

[ Bug-Fixes ]

Fixed a bug that caused ghosts to have a bugged uniform if they were wearing an outfit when they turned into a ghost.
Fixed a typo in an adaptable islander's "chat" problem.
Fixed a typo in the introduction cutscene.
Fixed a bug that caused "No Islanders Added" to appear on an islander's social media friends list despite having friends on said list. (HOPEFULLY!)
Fixed a bug that allowed you to play Card Roulette with islanders who are currently raising a child, and once you won, they'd be deleted forever. Essentially locking their baby into a state of limbo. Bad player! How dare you treat your pregnant islanders like this!
Fixed a bug that caused the sky to stay lit if it rained before 7 PM.
Fixed some lighting issues on lower-end computers that used the game's lower graphical settings.
Fixed an issue where if you entered the swatch menu while your islander has leveled up and backed out of the swatch menu, you would lose the level up "free item" perk the islander once had.

[ Additions/Improvements ]

[ WARNING : Your islanders may not be friends in this update. Due to internal issues, friendships have been reset in-game. This is mainly to due with the new confessions system that's being implemented for an upcoming update. ]

( Islanders )

 Added a new islander minigame that they can have as a problem -- "Find my Water"!
 Added a new "Fred On" dream.
 Islanders now have a new interaction they can perform if you preview their apartment.
 If your islanders are yapping too much, you can now skip their dialogue with a little skip button next to their name.
 You can now remove shirts/pants from an islander if you click on the current shirt/pants that they're wearing in the menu. This will add a tasteful censor effect to your islander.
 New soundtracks were added to both "Hexing an Islander" and "Islander Revival" minigames.
 Raised the chance for an islander to "absolutely dislike" a meal.
 Islanders can travel and visit Kiki's Island. Nature Whisperers will do this more than others.
 Ghost islanders can now roam anywhere. They're no longer confined to the apartments.
 Brought back the ability to see where an islander is by pressing on the Preview button on their apartment when they're out.
 Islanders will now get hungry less.


( Knits' Shop )

 Added a "Striped Dress" outfit.
 Added a "Prairie Dress" outfit.
 Added a "Tank-Top" shirt.
 Added a "Knitted" Sweater.
 Added a new "Scarf" accessory.
 Added a new "Spinning 3D Rhombus" accessory (includes 35 swatches).
 Added a new "Shoes (Sneakers)" accessory.
 Added a new "Phrygian Cap" accessory.
 Added a new "Fly High" cape accessory.
 Added a new "High Hoppers" rabbit ears accessory.
 Added 18 new swatches for Long Socks and Short Socks.


( FOOD )

 Added "Pickle" as an ingredient.
 Added "Fried Pickles" as a new meal to buy/make.


( Town Hall )

 Fixed the weird open gap between the buttons and the bottom of the screen.


( The Room Editor )

 Added a new "Dreamweave" rug under the "Study" tab.


( Islander Apartments )

 Fixed up the UI and compressed multiple buttons into one menu.


( Aliens )

 Added new "Hearts" antennas.


( Babies )

 Babies will now use "walkers" once they are able to start freely walking around instead of crawling.


( Toasty Takes Flight )

 Replaced the old soundtrack with a completely new and original one.

notes.title: Early Access: V.02: The Food Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you're excited for this update as much as we are! This update introduces one of the things that I've wanted in New Day for a while: Food!

( Food )

Food in New Day is given to your islanders to keep their bellies satisfied. A hungry islander is an unhappy one!

How does food work you may ask? ( You can skip this part if you don't wanna read the technical mumbo-jumbo! )

Islanders, upon being created, generate with a random "like" to "dislike" ratio to ingredients based on their personality. For example, evil islanders will hate ingredients a lot more than cheerful islanders would. Islanders can generate with: Most Hated, Hated, Neutral, Loved, Most Loved to ingredients. Once generated, they're here to stay... so no changing your islander's minds! Upon giving a food item to your islander, the game will check the food for the ingredients within it and calculate which ingredients the islanders are neutral, hated, most hated, loved, or most loved towards. They'll be added up or subtracted into a final number, and that final number will determine their outcome of what they think of the food. Eventually, I'd like to add an "Allergy" system to New Day that allows your islanders to be allergic to certain ingredients. Being allergic to ingredients would cause them to automatically lose 2 "final number" points for every ingredient in the meal that they're allergic to. For every ingredient that causes this point loss, it'd add into their "sick meter" and cause them to catch colds more often... or worse! Of course, that's all future content... there's nothing to worry about... yet...

Food can be bought within MemoMart and given straight to your islander... or... you can buy a recipe, look at the ingredients to make said food and buy the ingredients in order to play that specific food's cooking minigames. Playing a food's cooking minigames will allow you to get a negative or positive boost on said food depending on how you did in the minigames. This boost will be applied to the islander's opinion of the food if they haven't ate said food before.

Wow, THAT was a mouthful. Literally.

( Bait )

You can now use bait to lower the difficulty of the fishing minigame! Each bait goes up by 5% in how slower your fishing rod spins around the wheel. It... didn't take long to put this into the game. It kind of makes me wonder why I didn't do it sooner... Oh well. At least this means it's now time to work on confessions... I mean... what? Did I say something? Hm. Must've been the wind.

( Quirks )

You can now give your islanders "Quirks"! Quirks are small details that you can add to your islander to make their personality more defined. Despite only currently having a small amount to choose from, we'll be adding more into future updates.

Now that that's out of the way, here's a list of bug-fixes, additions, and quality of life updates for New Day:

[ Fixes ]


 Fixed a bug that caused islanders memories to duplicate if you give them a new apartment.
 Fixed a piece of dialogue that showed (islandername) instead of your islander's name when islanders were told no to befriending another islander.
 Fixed a slight issue where the "leveling up" ringtone can be heard slightly after a few seconds before the happy soundtrack begins to play.
 Fixed an oversight that would cause islanders to not import properly if they had an apartment value higher than the current count of apartments on the island they were transferred into. You should be able to properly share islander's again with no issues!
 Fixed an oversight where the button's text would overflow off of the button in the Room Chooser screen if the apartment name was long enough.
 Fixed a slight oversight that charged you for subscribing your islander to the newspaper instead of charging your islander if they had enough money.
 Fixed a bug that caused fairies in Card Roulette to spawn on the floor instead of hovering in the air.
 Optimized Rain and Snow so that the game has less particles to render, therefore allowing more FPS.
 Fixed the tooltips going off-screen or being squished into the center when the resolution of New Day wasn't at the maximum!
 Fixed a bug that would softlock the game if you had an outfit on and tried applying a clothing item that contains swatches.
 Fixed typo in "Cannot Change into Clothes" notification.
 Removed Fryc.


[ Additions/Improvements ]

( Islanders )

 Islanders will no longer want to brush another islanders teeth if they're friends with the islander.
 Islanders will now lose a significant amount of friendship with the islander that complained about their "disgusting breath" before the "Brushing Teeth" minigame.
 Islanders will no longer dance after the "leveling up" music finishes when they level up.
 You can now set a catchphrase for your islander to occasionally say when you enter their apartment.
 Sped up the scroll speed for the screen that allows you to give an islander an apartment.
 Your islander's apartment windows will now glow if they're awake during the night.
 Islanders will now have more occurring problems on your island, even without the "Golly Gossipin' Time" Ordinance.
 You can now tell when your islander has a problem without entering the apartment complex!
 Lowered the probability to 35% chance of an islander rejecting your advances to solve their problem if they had a low opinion of you. Previously, they had a 50% chance. This was just way too high.
 Added an "Islander Interaction Wheel" in your islanders apartments.
 Added "Draw a Picture" into the Islander Interaction Wheel.
 Added "Resurrect an Islander" into the Islander Interaction Wheel.

notes.title: New Day: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Hello! Welcome to New Day: Early Access!

We here at Scrapbook Studios know that a lot of you have been waiting for the release of New Day, and we're pleased to bring it to you! 

Before I begin, I'd like to say a few things:

New Day is very near and dear to my heart. It holds a special place that I cannot describe. It started as a small project in 2022 to see if I was capable of creating something similar to Tomodachi Life. And in 2023, it was scrapped and recreated from the ground-up with new programming, soundtracks, and more. The previous version of the game felt too much like Tomodachi Life and we wanted to make this project our own thing to try and stray away from that viewpoint as a whole. Obviously, we're still deemed within the same genre, but in its entirety, New Day is its own unique experience. 

That being said, Early Access is released, and it doesn't contain as much content as I wanted it to have. I struggled to keep motivated in 2024 and it shows... A LOT! I went on a 3 month burnout spree that resulted in nothing getting done in the 2nd half of the year. Only at the end of 2024, in November, did I find a perfect routine to help prevent burnout but also allowed me to work on the game even more! I'm really excited about some upcoming features scheduled for 2025, and we think you will be too! 

Some crucial key components are currently missing from the game, such as Hunger, most buildings, lack of objects in The Room Editor, etc... we're currently working our hardest to get everything done as soon as possible. And from us here at Scrapbook Studios, thank you. Thank you for becoming apart of our development journey.

Have a Merry Christmas! We'll see you all again pretty soon... something interesting lurks around the corner... an update that you're all STARVING for. Yeah. You're HUNGRY for this update. You'll EAT this update right up. Okay. I'll stop.

notes.title: New Day's Demo Release
notes.notes:
After a long wait, the demo for New Day is finally out. For now, it only includes the islander creator, but eventually, it'll include much more than that.

Here's a Q&A for the more curious islanders out there.

What'll happen after the Islander Creator's release?

We'll begin updating the game to allow players to experience more than just the islander creator. The goal is to update the game consistently while it's in active development as a "demo", and upon full release, all content from previous demo versions will be available to play.

But, if you release all content within the demo, what surprises will be in the final release?

Not everything will be fully unlocked in the demo. Some shops, accessories, minigames, etc... will be locked until the final game, unless you're a V.I.P Islander in our patreon, then you'll gain access to that version of the game, too.

Is there an estimated release date?

Not currently. But we're aiming for 2025 - 2026. Although it could still take longer than that. That might be disappointing to hear, but we really are trying our best.

If you have any questions, be sure to join the discord! You can find it on the steam page.
